# function: bedrock_agentcore_policy_generation

Builds the ARN of an `bedrock-agentcore` `policy-generation`:

```
arn:${Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${Region}:${Account}:policy-engine/${PolicyEngineId}/policy-generation/${PolicyGenerationId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
bedrock_agentcore_policy_generation(policy_engine_id string, policy_generation_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `policy_engine_id` (String) Value for `${PolicyEngineId}` in the ARN template.
1. `policy_generation_id` (String) Value for `${PolicyGenerationId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
